description:
The Experteer AI Career Assistant helps ambitious professionals and executives navigate job search more efficiently. Describe your target role, seniority, industry, and preferences, and get personalized, actionable guidance to discover relevant opportunities and refine your search strategy.

Use it to:

* Define and clarify your target roles (titles, scope, seniority)
* Translate your goals into better search criteria and keywords
* Explore adjacent roles and alternative title variations you may be missing
* Prioritize opportunities based on your preferences (industry, location, compensation focus, company type)
* Stay organized with a clearer shortlist and next steps for your search

More career-support capabilities may be added over time.

defaultPrompt: Find senior product managers near me
